_comment: The property being sold. Fixed input, not scraped. Every field carries where it came from, because the outreach draws its claims from here and a claim with no source cannot leave the building.

venue.name: Astral Valley Art Park
venue.distance_note: About 45 minutes south of St. Louis

claims.value: about 7,500 per day, implying about 22,500 admissions across three days

attendance.reason: Two client-supplied figures that do not reconcile, and they measure different things — total attendees against daily admissions. An inaugural festival has no gate history to settle it. No attendance number may appear in outreach until the client states one.
attendance.resolves_when: Client confirms a single figure and says whether it counts unique attendees or daily admissions.

packages.inventory_reason: Sponsorship inventory was named as a required input and never delivered. Without it a draft cannot name what a sponsor actually receives.

window.close_by_note: Two to three weeks to lock in a deal

sender.name: Robert Dittrich
sender.authority_reason: The sending account and outreach permissions were never established. Every draft stays a draft until they are.
